description: This file defines an enum 'WindowPlacement' that provides utility functions to calculate window placement frames such as centered, top-right, anchored below a certain rect, and ensuring the window stays on screen. These functions are mainly focused on calculating and adjusting window frames within specified screen bounds, primarily for macOS applications using AppKit.

methods.name: centeredFrame
methods.description: Calculates a centered window frame of a given size within a specified bounds.

methods.name: topRightFrame
methods.description: Determines a frame positioned at the top right corner with padding within specified bounds.

methods.name: anchoredBelowFrame
methods.description: Calculates a frame below a specified anchor rect with padding, adjusted to stay within bounds.

methods.name: ensureOnScreen
methods.description: Adjusts a window's position to ensure it is visible on some screen, defaulting to center if necessary.
